0022600176.text: The Brooklyn Nets (1-6, 0-3 at home) host the Charlotte Hornets (3-5) in the Nets' eighth game of the season, as they come off a loss and sit 14th in the East and 5th in the Atlantic, 5.5 games back. Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain) are out for Brooklyn, while Charlotte, who have lost four straight and sit 3rd in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, are missing Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel, both with hamstring injuries. The Nets trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 110-103 loss in Brooklyn on October 21, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
